raw_problem.problem_text:
$$
\chi = A \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 - 2 \mathrm {i} \\ 2 \end{array} \right).
$$

(a) 归一化 $\chi$ 确定常数 $A$   
(b) 测量 $S _ { z }$ 分量，得到哪些值?相应的几率是多少? $S _ { z }$ 的期望值是什么?  
(c) 测量 $S _ { x }$ 分量，得到哪些值?相应的几率是多少? $S _ { x }$ 的期望值是什么?  
(d) 测量 $S _ { y }$ 分量，得到哪些值?相应的几率是多少? $S _ { y }$ 的期望值是什么?
raw_problem.solution_text:
a) 披函数归一化

$$
1 = \chi^ {\dagger} \chi = | A | ^ {2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 + 2 \mathrm {i} & 2 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 - 2 \mathrm {i} \\ 2 \end{array} \right) = 9 | A | ^ {2},
$$

$$
A = \frac {1}{3}.
$$

量得到 $\frac { \hbar } { 2 }$ (自旋向上)的几率为

$$
P _ {+} = | A (1 - 2 \mathrm {i}) | ^ {2} = 5 | A | ^ {2} = \frac {5}{9},
$$

测量得到 $- { \frac { \hbar } { 2 } }$ (自旋向下)的几率为

$$
P _ {-} = | 2 A | ^ {2} = 4 | A | ^ {2} = \frac {4}{9}.
$$

期望值为

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle S _ {z} \rangle = \chi^ {\dagger} S _ {z} \chi = A ^ {*} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 + 2 \mathrm {i} & 2 \end{array} \right) \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right) A \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 - 2 \mathrm {i} \\ 2 \end{array} \right) \\ = 5 | A | ^ {2} \frac {\hbar}{2} + 4 | A | ^ {2} \left(- \frac {\hbar}{2}\right) = P _ {+} \frac {\hbar}{2} + P _ {-} \left(- \frac {\hbar}{2}\right) = \frac {1}{1 8} \hbar . \\ \end{array}
$$

(c) $S _ { z }$ 的表象， $S _ { x }$ 的本征矢量为

$\chi _ { + } ^ { ( x ) } = \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { 2 } } \left( \begin{array} { c } { { 1 } } \\ { { 1 } } \end{array} \right)$ ，本征值为 $\begin{array} { c } { { \displaystyle { J \frac { \hbar } { 2 } ; \chi _ { - } ^ { ( x ) } = \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { 2 } } \left( \begin{array} { c } { { 1 } } \\ { { - 1 } } \end{array} \right) } } } \end{array}$ ，本征的 $- \frac { \hbar } { 2 }$

测量 $S _ { x }$ 得到; $\frac { \hbar } { 2 }$ 的几率为

$$
P _ {+} ^ {(x)} = \left| \left(\chi_ {+} ^ {(x)}\right) ^ {\dagger} \chi \right| ^ {2} = \left| \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 1 \end{array} \right) \frac {1}{3} \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 - 2 \mathrm {i} \\ 2 \end{array} \right) \right| ^ {2} = \frac {1}{1 8} | 1 - 2 \mathrm {i} + 2 | ^ {2} = \frac {1 3}{1 8},
$$

测量 $S _ { x }$ 得到- $- { \frac { \hbar } { 2 } }$ 的几率为

$$
P _ {-} ^ {(x)} = \left| \left(\chi_ {-} ^ {(x)}\right) ^ {\dagger} \chi \right| ^ {2} = \left| \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & - 1 \end{array} \right) \frac {1}{3} \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 - 2 \mathrm {i} \\ 2 \end{array} \right) \right| ^ {2} = \frac {1}{1 8} | 1 - 2 \mathrm {i} - 2 | ^ {2} = \frac {5}{1 8}.
$$

$S _ { x }$ ，的期望值为

$$
\langle S _ {x} \rangle = \chi^ {\dagger} \boldsymbol {\mathcal {S}} _ {x} \chi = \frac {1}{3} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 + 2 \mathrm {i} & 2 \end{array} \right) \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) \frac {1}{3} \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 - 2 \mathrm {i} \\ 2 \end{array} \right) = \frac {4}{9} \frac {\hbar}{2},
$$

或者

$$
\langle S _ {x} \rangle = P _ {+} ^ {(x)} \frac {\hbar}{2} + P _ {-} ^ {(x)} \left(- \frac {\hbar}{2}\right) = \frac {1 3}{1 8} \frac {\hbar}{2} + \frac {5}{1 8} \left(- \frac {\hbar}{2}\right) = \frac {4}{9} \frac {\hbar}{2}.
$$

(d) $S _ { z }$ 的表象， $S _ { y }$ 的本征矢量为

$\chi _ { + } ^ { ( y ) } = \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { 2 } } \left( \begin{array} { l } { 1 } \\ { \mathrm { ~ i ~ } } \end{array} \right)$ d) ，本阳 为；x $| \frac { \hbar } { 2 } ; \chi _ { - } ^ { ( y ) } = \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { 2 } } \left( \begin{array} { c } { { 1 } } \\ { { - \mathrm { i } } } \end{array} \right)$ $- \frac { \hbar } { 2 }$

测量 $S _ { y }$ 到; $\frac { \hbar } { 2 }$ 几率为

$$
P_{+}^{(y)} = \left|\Bigl(\chi_{+}^{(y)}\Bigr)^{\dagger}\chi \right|^{2} = \left|\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\left( \begin{array}{cc}1 & -\mathrm{i} \end{array} \right)\frac{1}{3}\left( \begin{array}{c}1 - 2\mathrm{i}\\ 2 \end{array} \right)\right|^{2} = \frac{1}{18} |1 - 2\mathrm{i} - 2\mathrm{i}|^{2} = \frac{17}{18},
$$

测量 $S _ { y }$ 得到 $- { \frac { \hbar } { 2 } }$ 的几率为

$$
P _ {-} ^ {(y)} = \left| \left(\chi_ {-} ^ {(y)}\right) ^ {\dagger}   \chi \right| ^ {2} = \left| \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & \mathrm {i} \end{array} \right) \frac {1}{3} \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 - 2 \mathrm {i} \\ 2 \end{array} \right) \right| ^ {2} = \frac {1}{1 8}   | 1 - 2 \mathrm {i} + 2 \mathrm {i} | ^ {2} = \frac {1}{1 8}.
$$

$S _ { y }$ 的期望值为

$$
\langle S _ {y} \rangle = \chi^ {\dagger} \boldsymbol {S} _ {y} \chi = \frac {1}{3} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 + 2 \mathrm {i} & 2 \end{array} \right) \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) \frac {1}{3} \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 - 2 \mathrm {i} \\ 2 \end{array} \right) = \frac {8}{9} \frac {\hbar}{2},
$$

或者

$$
\langle S _ {y} \rangle = P _ {+} ^ {(y)} \frac {\hbar}{2} + P _ {-} ^ {(y)} \left(- \frac {\hbar}{2}\right) = \frac {1 7}{1 8} \frac {\hbar}{2} + \frac {1}{1 8} \left(- \frac {\hbar}{2}\right) = \frac {8}{9} \frac {\hbar}{2}.
$$

串串串习题 4.59 假设两个自旋为 1/2 的粒子处在单态(方程 (4.176)) ，设 $S _ { a } ^ { ( 1 ) }$ 为粒的自旋角动量在矢量 $^ { a }$ 方向上的分量同样， $S _ { b } ^ { ( 2 ) }$ 为粒子 的自旋角动量在矢量 $^ { b }$ 方向上的分量.证明:

$$
\left<   S _ {a} ^ {(1)} S _ {b} ^ {(2)} \right> = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4} \cos \theta ,
$$

其中。 $\theta$ 为矢量 $^ { a }$ 与 $^ { b }$ 之间的夹角.

证明设 $^ { a }$ 的方向为 $z$ 轴方向 $^ { b }$ 的方向在 $B = \pm \sqrt { \frac { s _ { 2 } \mp m + 1 / 2 } { 2 s _ { 2 } + 1 } }$ 平面内，所以

$$
S _ {a} ^ {(1)} = S _ {z} ^ {(1)}, \quad S _ {b} ^ {(2)} = \cos \theta S _ {z} ^ {(2)} + \sin \theta S _ {x} ^ {(2)}.
$$

我们需要计算 $\left. 0 0 \right| S _ { a } ^ { ( 1 ) } S _ { b } ^ { ( 2 ) } \left| 0 0 \right.$ ，由藕合表象与无藕合表象基矢之间的关系

$$
| 0 0 \rangle = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} [ \uparrow \downarrow - \downarrow \uparrow ],
$$

以及

$$
S _ {z} \uparrow = \frac {\hbar}{2} \uparrow , S _ {z} \downarrow = - \frac {\hbar}{2} \downarrow , S _ {x} \uparrow = \frac {\hbar}{2} \downarrow , S _ {x} \downarrow = \frac {\hbar}{2} \uparrow ,
$$

得

$$
\begin{array}{l} S _ {a} ^ {(1)} S _ {b} ^ {(2)} \left| 0 0 \right\rangle = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left[ S _ {z} ^ {(1)} \left(\cos \theta S _ {z} ^ {(2)} + \sin \theta S _ {x} ^ {(2)}\right) \right] (\uparrow \downarrow - \downarrow \uparrow) \\ = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left\{\left(\frac {\hbar}{2} \uparrow\right) \left[ \cos \theta \left(- \frac {\hbar}{2} \downarrow\right) + \sin \theta \left(\frac {\hbar}{2} \uparrow\right) \right] \right. \\ \left. - \left(- \frac {\hbar}{2} \downarrow\right) \left[ \cos \theta \left(\frac {\hbar}{2} \uparrow\right) + \sin \theta \left(\frac {\hbar}{2} \downarrow\right) \right] \right\} \\ = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} (- \cos \theta \uparrow \downarrow + \sin \theta \uparrow \uparrow + \cos \theta \downarrow \uparrow + \sin \theta \downarrow \downarrow) \\ = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4} \left[ - \cos \theta \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} (\uparrow \downarrow - \downarrow \uparrow) + \sin \theta \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} (\uparrow \uparrow + \downarrow \downarrow) \right] \\ = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4} \left[ - \cos \theta | 0 0 \rangle + \sin \theta \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(| 1 1 \rangle + | 1 - 1 \rangle\right) \right]. \\ \end{array}
$$

由精合表象基矢的正交归一性，得

$$
\langle 0 0 | S _ {a} ^ {(1)} S _ {b} ^ {(2)} | 0 0 \rangle = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4} \cos \theta .
$$

串串串习题 4.60

(a) $s _ { 1 } = 1 / 2 , s _ { 2 }$ 为任意值时，求出 CG 系数.提示 这里需要求的是下式中的 $A$ 和 $B$

$$
\left| s m \right\rangle = A \left| \frac {1}{2} s _ {2} \frac {1}{2} \left(m - \frac {1}{2}\right) \right\rangle + B \left| \frac {1}{2} s _ {2} - \frac {1}{2} \left(m + \frac {1}{2}\right) \right\rangle ,
$$

满足 $| s \ m \rangle$ 是 $S ^ { 2 }$ 的一个本征态.使用方程 (4.177) $\sim$ (4.180) 的方法.如果不能计算出 $S _ { x } ^ { ( 2 ) }$ ( 例如)对 $\mid s _ { 2 } \ m _ { 2 } \rangle$ 的作用，请参考方程 (4.136) 和方程 (4.147) 前面的一行.

(b) 对照教材表 4.8 中的三个或四个条目验证这一普遍结论.

解答 (a) 由于 $S _ { \pm } = S _ { x } \pm \mathrm { i } S _ { y }$ ，所以

$$
S _ {x} = \frac {1}{2} \left(S _ {+} + S _ {-}\right), \quad S _ {y} = \frac {1}{2 i} \left(S _ {+} - S _ {-}\right).
$$

故

$$
\begin{array}{l} S _ {x} | s m \rangle = \frac {1}{2} \left[ S _ {+} | s m \rangle + S _ {-} | s m \rangle \right] \\ = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left[ \sqrt {s (s + 1) - m (m + 1)} | s m + 1 \rangle + \sqrt {s (s + 1) - m (m - 1)} | s m - 1 \rangle \right], \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} S _ {y} \left| s m \right\rangle = \frac {1}{2 \mathrm {i}} \left(S _ {+} \left| s m \right\rangle - S _ {-} \left| s m \right\rangle\right) \\ = \frac {1}{2 \mathrm {i}} \left[ \sqrt {s (s + 1) - m (m + 1)} | s m + 1 \rangle - \sqrt {s (s + 1) - m (m - 1)} | S m - 1 \rangle \right]. \\ \end{array}
$$

利用

$$
\begin{array}{l} S ^ {2} = \left(\boldsymbol {S} ^ {(1)} + \boldsymbol {S} ^ {(2)}\right) \cdot \left(\boldsymbol {S} ^ {(1)} + \boldsymbol {S} ^ {(2)}\right) = \left(S ^ {(1)}\right) ^ {2} + \left(S ^ {(2)}\right) ^ {2} + 2 \boldsymbol {S} ^ {(1)} \cdot \boldsymbol {S} ^ {(2)} \\ = \left(S ^ {(1)}\right) ^ {2} + \left(S ^ {(2)}\right) ^ {2} + 2 \left(S _ {x} ^ {(1)} S _ {x} ^ {(2)} + S _ {y} ^ {(1)} S _ {y} ^ {(2)} + S _ {z} ^ {(1)} S _ {z} ^ {(2)}\right), \\ \end{array}
$$

以及辑合表象基矢与无辑合表象基矢的关系

$$
\left| s m s _ {1} s _ {1} \right\rangle = \sum_ {m _ {1}} C _ {m _ {1}} \left| s _ {1} m _ {1} \right\rangle \left| s _ {2} m - m _ {1} \right\rangle .
$$

当 $s _ { 1 } = 1 / 2 , m _ { 1 } = \pm 1 / 2$ 时，

$$
\left| s m \right\rangle = A \left| \frac {1}{2} \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \left| s _ {2} m - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle + B \left| \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \left| s _ {2} m + \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle .
$$

A, $B$ 就是我们要求的 CG 系数

$$
S ^ {2} | s m \rangle = \left[ \left(S ^ {(1)}\right) ^ {2} + \left(S ^ {(2)}\right) ^ {2} + 2 \left(S _ {x} ^ {(1)} S _ {x} ^ {(2)} + S _ {y} ^ {(1)} S _ {y} ^ {(2)} + S _ {z} ^ {(1)} S _ {z} ^ {(2)}\right) \right]
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \times \left[ A \left| \frac {1}{2} \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \left| s _ {2} m - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle + B \left| \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \left| s _ {2} m + \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \right] \\ = A \left\{\left[ \left(S ^ {(1)}\right) ^ {2} \left| \frac {1}{2} \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \right] \left| s _ {2} m - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle + \left| \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \left[ \left(S ^ {(2)}\right) ^ {2} \left| s _ {2} m - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \right] \right. \\ + 2 \left[ \left(S _ {x} ^ {(1)} \left| \frac {1}{2} \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle\right) \left(S _ {x} ^ {(2)} \left| s _ {2} m - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle\right) + \left(S _ {y} ^ {(1)} \left| \frac {1}{2} \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle\right) \right. \\ \left. \times \left(S _ {y} ^ {(2)} \left| s _ {2} m - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle\right) + \left(S _ {z} ^ {(1)} \left| \frac {1}{2} \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle\right) \left(S _ {z} ^ {(2)} \left| s _ {2} m - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle\right) \right] \rbrace \\ + B \left\{\left[ \left(S ^ {(1)}\right) ^ {2} \left| \begin{array}{c c} 1 & - \frac {1}{2} \\ & \end{array} \right\rangle \right] \left| s _ {2} m + \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle + \left| \frac {1}{2} \quad \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \left[ \left(S ^ {(2)}\right) ^ {2} \left| s _ {2} m + \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \right] \right. \\ + 2 \left[ \left(S _ {x} ^ {(1)} \left| \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle\right) \left(S _ {x} ^ {(2)} \left| s _ {2} m + \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle\right) + \left(S _ {y} ^ {(1)} \left| \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle\right) \right. \\ \left. \times \left(S _ {y} ^ {(2)} \left| s _ {2} m + \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle\right) + \left(S _ {z} ^ {(1)} \left| \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle\right) \left(S _ {z} ^ {(2)} \left| s _ {2} m + \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle\right) \right] \rbrace \\ = A \left\{\frac {3}{4} \hbar^ {2} \left| \frac {1}{2} \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \left| s _ {2} m - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle + \hbar^ {2} s _ {2} (s _ {2} + 1) \left| \frac {1}{2} \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \left| s _ {2} m - \frac {1}{2} \right. \right\rangle \\ + 2 \left[ \frac {\hbar}{2} \left| \frac {1}{2} \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \frac {\hbar}{2} \left(\sqrt {s _ {2} (s _ {2} + 1) - \left(m - \frac {1}{2}\right) \left(m + \frac {1}{2}\right)} \mid s _ {2} m + \frac {1}{2} \right. \right\rangle \\ + \sqrt {s _ {2} (s _ {2} + 1) - \left(m - \frac {1}{2}\right) \left(m - \frac {3}{2}\right)} \left| s _ {2} m - \frac {3}{2} \right\rangle \Bigg) \\ + \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar}{2} \left| \frac {1}{2} \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \frac {\hbar}{2 \mathrm {i}} \left(\sqrt {s _ {2} (s _ {2} + 1) - \left(m - \frac {1}{2}\right) \left(m + \frac {1}{2}\right)} \mid s _ {2} m + \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \\ \left. - \sqrt {s _ {2} \left(s _ {2} + 1\right) - \left(m - \frac {1}{2}\right) \left(m - \frac {3}{2}\right)} \left| s _ {2} m - \frac {3}{2} \right\rangle\right) \\ \left. \left. + \frac {\hbar}{2} \left| \frac {1}{2} \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \hbar \left(m - \frac {1}{2}\right) \left| s _ {2} m - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \right] \right\} \\ + B \left\{\frac {3}{4} \hbar^ {2} \left| \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \left| s _ {2} m + \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle + \hbar^ {2} s _ {2} (s _ {2} + 1) \left| \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \left| s _ {2} m + \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \right. \\ + 2 \left[ \frac {\hbar}{2} \left| \frac {1}{2} \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \frac {\hbar}{2} \left(\sqrt {s _ {2} (s _ {2} + 1) - \left(m + \frac {1}{2}\right) \left(m + \frac {3}{2}\right)} \mid s _ {2} m + \frac {3}{2} \right. \right\rangle \\ \left. + \sqrt {s _ {2} \left(s _ {2} + 1\right) - \left(m + \frac {1}{2}\right) \left(m - \frac {1}{2}\right)} \left| s _ {2} m - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle\right) \\ - \frac {\mathrm {i} \hbar}{2} \left| \frac {1}{2} \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \frac {\hbar}{2 \mathrm {i}} \left(\sqrt {s _ {2} (s _ {2} + 1) - \left(m + \frac {1}{2}\right) \left(m + \frac {3}{2}\right)} \mid s _ {2} m + \frac {3}{2} \right\rangle \\ \left. - \sqrt {s _ {2} \left(s _ {2} + 1\right) - \left(m + \frac {1}{2}\right) \left(m - \frac {1}{2}\right)} \left| s _ {2} m - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle\right) \\ \left. - \frac {\hbar}{2} \left| \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \hbar \left(m + \frac {1}{2}\right) \left| s _ {2} m + \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \right] \Bigg \}. \\ \end{array}
$$

可以看出上式中 $\left| s _ { 2 } \ m \pm \frac { 3 } { 2 } \right.$ 项被相互抵消，按 $\left| \frac { 1 } { 2 } \ \frac { 1 } { 2 } \right. \left| s _ { 2 } \ m - \frac { 1 } { 2 } \right.$ $\left| \frac { 1 } { 2 } \right. \left. - \frac { 1 } { 2 } \right. \left| s _ { 2 } \ m + \frac { 1 } { 2 } \right.$ 集

项，得

$$
\begin{array}{l} s \left(s + 1\right) | s m \rangle = s \left(s + 1\right)\left( \right.A \left| \right. \frac {1}{2} \quad \frac {1}{2} \left. \right\rangle\left| \right. s _ {2} m - \frac {1}{2} \left. \right\rangle + B \left|\begin{array}{c c}\frac {1}{2}&- \frac {1}{2}\end{array}\right.\left. \right\rangle\left| \right. s _ {2} m + \frac {1}{2} \left. \right\rangle\left. \right) \\ = \hbar^ {2} \left\{A \left[ \frac {3}{4} + s _ {2} (s _ {2} + 1) + m - \frac {1}{2} \right] \right. \\ \left. + B \sqrt {s _ {2} \left(s _ {2} + 1\right) - \left(m - \frac {1}{2}\right) \left(m + \frac {1}{2}\right)} \right\} \left| \frac {1}{2} \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \left| s _ {2} m - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \\ + \hbar^ {2} \left\{B \left[ \frac {3}{4} + s _ {2} (s _ {2} + 1) - m - \frac {1}{2} \right] \right. \\ \left. + A \sqrt {s _ {2} \left(s _ {2} + 1\right) - \left(m - \frac {1}{2}\right) \left(m + \frac {1}{2}\right)} \right\} \left| \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle \left| s _ {2} m + \frac {1}{2} \right\rangle . \\ \end{array}
$$

由此得到所求 $B$ 满足的方程为

$$
A \left[ s _ {2} (s _ {2} + 1) - s (s + 1) + \frac {1}{4} + m \right] + B \sqrt {s _ {2} (s _ {2} + 1) - m ^ {2} + \frac {1}{4}} = 0,
$$

$$
B \left[ s _ {2} (s _ {2} + 1) - s (s + 1) + \frac {1}{4} - m \right] + A \sqrt {s _ {2} (s _ {2} + 1) - m ^ {2} + \frac {1}{4}} = 0.
$$

这个方程组有非零解的条件是系数行列式等于零，即

$$
\left[ s _ {2} (s _ {2} + 1) - s (s + 1) + \frac {1}{4} \right] ^ {2} - m ^ {2} - \left[ s _ {2} (s _ {2} + 1) - m ^ {2} + \frac {1}{4} \right] = 0.
$$

由此，得

$$
\left[ s _ {2} (s _ {2} + 1) - s (s + 1) + \frac {1}{4} \right] ^ {2} = s _ {2} ^ {2} + s _ {2} + \frac {1}{4} = \left(s _ {2} + \frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {2},
$$

$$
\left[ s _ {2} (s _ {2} + 1) - s (s + 1) + \frac {1}{4} - \left(s _ {2} + \frac {1}{2}\right) \right]
$$

$$
\cdot \left[ s _ {2} (s _ {2} + 1) - s (s + 1) + \frac {1}{4} + \left(s _ {2} + \frac {1}{2}\right) \right] = 0,
$$

$$
